from app.api.handlers import handle_search_users

def test_search():
    # Valid search
    status, data = handle_search_users({"q": "Ada"})
    assert status == 200
    assert len(data["users"]) == 1
    assert data["users"][0]["name"] == "Ada Lovelace"

    # Case insensitive
    status, data = handle_search_users({"q": "ada"})
    assert status == 200
    assert len(data["users"]) == 1
    assert data["users"][0]["name"] == "Ada Lovelace"

    # Multiple results
    status, data = handle_search_users({"q": "a"})
    assert status == 200
    assert len(data["users"]) == 3

    # Invalid queries
    assert handle_search_users({})[0] == 400
    assert handle_search_users({"q": ""})[0] == 400
    assert handle_search_users({"q": "   "})[0] == 400
    assert handle_search_users({"q": 123})[0] == 400

test_search()
